summary.text: Jamie Thompson is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 28 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She works as a nurse.

paragraphs.text: Jamie Thompson was born in Dearborn, Michigan, and attended the Detroit Business Institute in 2011.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse.
Thompson assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session she is majority vice chair of the Health Policy Committee and also sits on the Energy, Families, Children, and Seniors, House Regulatory Reform, and Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses committees.
